ValidationRule.description: If the due date of the Account Review case on or before the 28th of the month, the Review Period End Date can not be in the previous month or this month. Else, Review Period End Date cannot be in the same month.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND(RecordTypeId = '01290000000A8Cb', DAY( Due_Date__c ) <= 27, OR((MONTH(Review_Period_End_Date__c)= MONTH( Due_Date__c)), (MONTH(Review_Period_End_Date__c)= MONTH( Due_Date__c)-1), AND(MONTH(Due_Date__c)=1, MONTH( Review_Period_End_Date__c)=12))),
AND(RecordTypeId = '01290000000A8Cb', DAY( Due_Date__c ) > 27, (MONTH(Review_Period_End_Date__c)= MONTH( Due_Date__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Review Period End Date can not be in the previous month or this month
